subject: privacy policy
title: What If You Actually Read Every Privacy Policy?

scenes.text: What if you actually read every privacy policy you click past? Clear your calendar.
Researchers at Carnegie Mellon found the typical policy runs about 2,500 words.
The average American meets around 1,460 of them in a single year.
Reading them all would take about 250 hours. That's 76 full working days.
Across the whole country, that's roughly 54 billion hours of reading.
Valued as work time, it's about 781 billion dollars a year. That's why nobody reads them.

description:
What if you read every privacy policy you agreed to? A Carnegie Mellon study by Aleecia McDonald and Lorrie Cranor estimated the median policy at 2,514 words, and about 1,462 policies a year per person.
Reading them all would take around 76 working days a year, about 54 billion hours nationally, worth roughly 781 billion dollars.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Have you ever read one all the way through? Tell us the what-if you want next.
